Miloje Savic and Jennifer L. Dembinski
CTL provided solutions: Capture Solution, Detection Solution, Tertiary Solution, Blue Developer and Red Developer Solution (see Solutions)
Washing buffer (see Solutions)
Sterile disposable tips

•	Thaw, wash and prepare PBMC; bring to a concentration of 4million cells/ml in Aim-V media (ThermoFisher Scientific). Let the cells ‘rest’ in a 37˚C humidified 5% CO2 incubator while preparing plate.

•	Plate the antigen/mitogen solutions: 100µl Aim-V media/well, then 50µl of each antigen/mitogen solution/well. Place the plate in a 37˚C humidified 5% CO2 incubator for 15 minutes to ensure ideal temperature/pH.
•	Prepare wash solutions for the day: PBS, distilled water and Tween-PBS (see Wash Buffers).
•	Prepare IFNγ/GranzymeB Detection Solution (see Solutions).
•	Prepare Tertiary Solution (see Solutions).
•	Wash plate 3x with 0.05% Tween-PBS, 200µl/well.
•	Add 80µl/well of Tertiary Solution (see Solutions). Incubate at room temperature, 30 minutes.
•	Prepare Red and Blue Developer Solution (see Solutions).
IFNγ spots are Red colored
Granzyme B spots are Blue colored
http://www.immunospot.com/includes/pdfs/protocols2/Hu_GrzB_IFNG_DC_Enz_Protocol.pdf
Human IFNγ/Granzyme B Dual Color Enzymatic Solutions
Important: All solutions should be freshly made prior to use
Wash Buffers (not included in the kit)
For each plate prepare:
•	0.05% Tween-PBS: 75µl Tween-20 in 150ml PBS
•	PBS, sterile, 100ml
•	Distilled water, 100ml

steps.title: Set up sterile work area
steps.instruction: Work under sterile conditions in a class II laminar flow biosafety cabinet.

steps.title: Prepare all reagents
steps.instruction: Make the following solutions as described:

substeps.instruction: 70 % ethanol: mix 7 ml 190‑200 proof ethanol with 3 ml distilled water (total 10 ml).
Capture Solution: add 40 µl IFNγ capture antibody and 80 µl Granzyme B capture antibody to 10 ml Diluent A.
Detection Solution: add 40 µl IFNγ detection antibody and 10 µl Granzyme B detection antibody to 10 ml Diluent B.
Tertiary Solution: add 10 µl Strep‑AP (1:1000) and 10 µl FITC‑HRP (1:1000) to 10 ml Diluent C.
Blue Developer Solution (Granzyme B): to 10 ml Diluent Blue add 160 µl S1, mix; add 160 µl S2, mix; add 92 µl S3, mix. Prepare within 10 min of use and protect from light.
Red Developer Solution (IFNγ): to 10 ml Diluent Red add 180 µl R1, mix; add 160 µl R2, mix. Prepare within 10 min of use and protect from light.

steps.title: Pre‑wet plate with ethanol
steps.instruction: Remove the protective underdrain from the 96‑well ELISpot plate, add 15 µl 70 % ethanol to each well, then immediately add 150 µl PBS to each well and wash the plate three additional times with 150 µl PBS per wash.

steps.title: Coat plate with capture antibodies
steps.instruction: Add 80 µl per well of the IFNγ/Granzyme B Capture Solution, replace the underdrain without puncturing the membrane, seal the plate, and incubate at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Remove capture solution and wash
steps.instruction: Decant the capture solution from the plate (Day 0) and wash once with 150 µl PBS per well.

steps.title: Add PBMCs
steps.instruction: Add gently 50 µl of the prepared PBMC suspension to each well.

steps.title: Incubate cells with antigen
steps.instruction: Place the plate immediately into a 37 °C humidified 5 % CO₂ incubator and incubate for 18–24 h. Do not stack plates, avoid shaking, and do not touch the plate during incubation.

steps.title: Wash post‑incubation
steps.instruction: Wash the plate twice with 200 µl PBS per well, then twice with 200 µl 0.05 % Tween‑PBS per well.

steps.title: Add detection antibodies
steps.instruction: Add 80 µl per well of IFNγ/Granzyme B Detection Solution and incubate at room temperature for 2 h.

steps.title: Wash after detection
steps.instruction: Wash the plate twice with 200 µl 0.05 % Tween‑PBS per well, then twice with 200 µl distilled water per well.

steps.title: Develop Granzyme B (blue)
steps.instruction: Add 80 µl per well of Blue Developer Solution and incubate at room temperature for 15–20 min.

steps.title: Stop blue development
steps.instruction: Rinse the membrane gently with tap water, decant, and repeat the rinse three times.

steps.title: Wash after blue reaction
steps.instruction: Decant the plate, wash once with tap water, then wash once with 200 µl distilled water per well.

steps.title: Develop IFNγ (red)
steps.instruction: Add 80 µl per well of Red Developer Solution and incubate at room temperature for 5–10 min.

steps.title: Final rinse and underdrain removal
steps.instruction: Remove the protective underdrain and rinse the back of the plate with tap water.

steps.title: Air‑dry plate
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the plate for 2 h in a running hood (or 24 h face‑down on paper towels on the bench).

steps.title: Scan and count spots
steps.instruction: Scan the dried plate using an ELISpot analyzer (e.g., CTL ImmunoSpot Analyzer) and count IFNγ and Granzyme B spots.
